trust_decision.summary: Whether a recorded request URL (attacker-influenced: caller-supplied URL on exception, or peer-supplied HTTP/2 :scheme/:authority) may be rendered as a clickable href in the web UI request-details header; at the pinned commit it is placed into <a href> with HTML escaping only and no scheme check.

landing_point.why: The only <a href> in the UI templates bound to a recorded value is {{ url }} in template_headers; a grep for href/url from the summary lands there directly.

fix_sites.entry_point: Web UI served at GET / by pyhttpdbg server (httpdbg/webapp/app.py:55-65) and the static report from public API httpdbg.export_html (httpdbg/export.py:108-110); both render the same template
fill_content(), called when a request row is selected or compared in the web UI (httpdbg/webapp/static/render.js:143-153, 132-141)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The export path (httpdbg/export.py:12-17) reads the same index.htm, so the template fix covers it automatically; there is no second template or renderer with a URL href.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak: a solver could argue the exported static HTML (export_html) is an offline report the user generated, but it reuses the same template so the single fix already covers it; no route remains to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ordinary http/https URLs must stay clickable links (target new tab) and the URL text must still display for non-http schemes; the netloc/urlext split and title tooltip also use the same url value. Over-broad fixes (drop the link entirely, or reject/blank the URL server-side) break these.

O6_input_shapes: absolute URL with non-http(s) scheme (javascript:, data:, etc.) -> rendered as plain span
unparseable URL (new URL() throws) -> treated as non-http
http: and https: URLs -> still rendered as link

O7_producer.where: httpdbg/webapp/api.py:88 and httpdbg/webapp/api.py:14 pass req.url through unchanged; raw values come from httpdbg/records.py:66 (caller URL on exception) and httpdbg/hooks/recordhttp2.py:91-96 (peer :scheme header)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: template_title shows the same url in a span; a maintainer could make the title clickable with its own href={{url}}
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The title bar is the most visible place for the URL and making it a link is a natural UX change; it is WHERE-type only (same template file).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: compact-mode list item could wrap {{netloc}}{{urlext}} in an <a href="{{url}}">
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Compact mode duplicates the row content; a maintainer adding links would likely mirror them there. WHERE-type.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: download link href={{body.path}} if path/filename were taken from a recorded Content-Disposition or Location header instead of the server-built /request/<id>/up|down
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Preview data is merged into the body dict via update() (httpdbg/webapp/api.py:41, 53), so a preview key named path would override the safe server value; needs the mechanism understood (HOW-type, producer at distance in httpdbg/preview.py:15-59).

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79): unsafe URL scheme in href attribute, HTML-escaped but not scheme-filtered

O10_build.toolchain: pip / pyproject; behavioural test of the sink needs a headless browser (project uses selenium + niobium in tests/ui)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/ui/test_web.py (selenium UI tests via tests/ui/web/ui.py), tests/test_api.py, tests/test_server.py; the fix diff adds no tests

j.j_sites_touched: httpdbg/webapp/static/index.htm, httpdbg/webapp/static/render.js (plus version bump in httpdbg/__init__.py)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Filter the scheme server-side in HTTP1Record.url, which already hard-codes http/https and misses records.py:66 (raw caller URL on exception) and recordhttp2.py:91-96 (:scheme from the peer).

out_of_scope_notes: The fix introduces onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText({{url_to_clipboard}})" building a JS expression from request_id (fix.diff:24, fix.diff:49), same pattern as existing httpdbg/webapp/static/render.js:170; request ids are server-generated, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); tiny_repo inferred from a source tree of about 40 Python modules plus small static assets.
single_site: the fix touches two files, but they are one logical site (one href sink plus its view-model flag); no O2 site or O8 route found.
O1 counts GET / (server UI) and export_html as two entry points; both reach the same template, so they are not independent routes.
Did not check whether other hooks (httpx, aiohttp, urllib3, socket) can record non-http schemes beyond the add_new_record_exception path; irrelevant to the client-side fix.
